choices: readString throws IOException, which must be caught or declared with throws
The method must be marked static to use Files
explanation: IOException is a checked exception, so Java insists the code says what happens to it: either wrap the call in try/catch or add throws IOException to the method and let the caller decide. Catching Exception just to quiet the compiler also swallows the bugs you wanted to hear about.
